# Sunset-Speaks Class Management Demo by P-Devs

> Interactive portfolio demo of a role-based class management platform for administrators, teachers, and students.

## Canonical URL

- [Open the demo](https://cn-demo.pauuu.dev/)
- [Visit the P-Devs portfolio](https://pauuu.dev/)

## Demo behavior

- The app contains fictional sample school data for evaluation.
- Visitor-created data resets every day at 12:00 AM Asia/Manila.
- Default preview accounts survive the reset and cannot have their credentials changed.
- Do not enter real or sensitive information.
